visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top hero with H1, subheading and CTA on one side and an image beside it (not behind it)
visualCharacteristics.layout: split two-column, text left and image right on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: image. Row 2: H1 title, subheading paragraph, CTA link. A single row with two cells (text | image) also works

reuseGuidance: Use for top-of-page heroes where the image sits beside the copy. Use the base hero for full-bleed background images.
